entities.title: Run the browser locally
entities.summary: Serve the folder and open it with a repository's address.
entities.verify: The folder tree and the first folder appear, and the browser's console shows no errors.
entities.details: Served this way there is no Worker, so there is no GitHub sign-in: the page offers a pasted token instead. The Worker itself is checked with `npm test` ([its verification](worker/.dev/verification.json)).

entities.title: Check this description
entities.summary: Run both validators from the repository root after changing a .dev file or an actor.
entities.when: After changing any .dev folder, Actors/ or Meta/Agents.
entities.verify: The first prints what it validated with no error; the second ends with 0 problems.
entities.details: `Meta/Agents/` is a copy of `Agents/` from human-assisted-software-development; the validators find their schemas next to themselves and scan the whole repository. See AGENTS.md.

entities.title: Publish a new version
entities.summary: Merge the change to main; GitHub Actions deploys it.
entities.when: When the owner wants a change live.
steps: Wait for the Cyberspace explorer workflow to test and deploy it, or run it by hand from the Actions tab
entities.verify: https://cyberspace-explorer.com shows the change; the workflow's last step checks that the page and /auth/me answer.
